purpose: V-003 1:1 session manager (OneToOneSessions.tla). 'pass' configs enable every rule K1..K11; each 'violation' config disables one rule (or probes a design gap) and its counterexample is a regression vector. Generated by verification/prototypes/v003-sessions/tlc_runs.py gen.

models.claim: all rules K1..K11 on: S1..S5, C1, C2 hold with crash, duplicate delivery, weak bundle, rogue device, link+revoke
all rules on: S1..S5, C1, C2 hold across one backup restore (backups on a1, which both sends and receives)
all rules on: S1..S5, C1, C2 hold when the later-revoked device b3 is also a sender
all rules on: S1..S5, C1, C2 hold when b1 restores and the relay redelivers envelopes it processed before the restore (three messages)
